title: Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training from offline data has allowed for substantial progress in domains such as robotics, leading to general-purpose policies that can be easily applied zero-shot or efficiently finetuned for downstream tasks. However, these policies can still have poor generalization, both due to the choice of modeling objective and from learning from a static dataset. In this work, we focus on the challenging task of zero-shot goal generalization, where a policy is evaluated on unseen tasks that require combining its existing knowledge (compositional generalization). An avenue for improving a policy's generalization is by generating new experience with world models; however, such generation has proven difficult for longer horizons. Thus, to alleviate this issue, we propose TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model and allows for directly imagining novel outcomes that can be achieved by composing existing knowledge. translated_title: 基于几何视野模型的目标想象以实现策略泛化
translated_abstract: 从离线数据中进行训练已经在机器人等领域取得了长足进步，催生出可以零样本直接应用或高效微调以适应下游任务的通用策略。然而，这些策略的泛化能力仍然可能较差，原因既在于建模目标的选择，也在于从静态数据集中学习。在本工作中，我们聚焦于具有挑战性的零样本目标泛化任务，即策略需要在需要组合其已有知识的未见任务上进行评估（组合泛化）。提升策略泛化能力的一个途径是利用世界模型生成新的经验；然而，这种生成方式在较长时程上已被证明十分困难。因此，为缓解这一问题，我们提出了TD-Aug，它从几何视野模型中采样，能够直接想象出通过组合已有知识可以实现的新颖结果。我们证明，通过……
tldr: 提出TD-Aug方法，通过从几何视野模型中采样直接想象出组合已有知识可达成的新目标，从而提升策略在零样本目标泛化任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: Proposes TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model to directly imagine novel goals achievable by composing existing knowledge, thereby improving zero-shot goal generalization of policies.
